steps.title: Open the Cockpit
steps.narration: This is Tapeology's Cockpit — the home screen where a trader watches a simulated market tape play out live. There's nothing to sign into; it's ready right away.
steps.point_out: A ticker box invites you to try SIM-BUYER, one of the built-in demo scenarios.

steps.title: Type in a simulated ticker
steps.narration: Enter SIM-BUYER — a scripted scenario built to show what buyer-controlled tape looks like.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now shows SIM-BUYER.

steps.title: Watch the tape settle into Buyer Control
steps.narration: Click Watch, and the simulator replays the scripted tape. Within a few seconds it settles into Buyer Control.
steps.point_out: The Tape State panel reads buyer_control, confirming the scenario played out as scripted.

steps.title: Stop and try the opposite scenario
steps.narration: Stop the tape, ready to try its mirror-image scenario.
steps.point_out: The Watch button becomes available again for a new ticker.

steps.title: Type in the seller scenario
steps.narration: This time, enter SIM-SELLER — the scripted scenario for seller-controlled tape.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now shows SIM-SELLER.

steps.title: Watch it settle the other way — Seller Control
steps.narration: Click Watch again, and this time the tape settles into Seller Control — the simulator reliably reproduces either side on demand.
steps.point_out: The Tape State panel now reads seller_control.

steps.title: Review the trading journal
steps.narration: Every simulated session gets logged as a thesis in the journal, so a trader can look back later at what was watched and why.
steps.point_out: The journal list shows the SIM-BUYER entry that was just recorded.

steps.title: Browse replay studies
steps.narration: The Studies page holds journaled measurements from tape replays — always labeled as measurements, never as a trading signal.
steps.point_out: The "Replay studies" heading and its source options are visible.

steps.title: Check the performance ledger
steps.narration: The Performance page shows the simulated profit ledger for the founding baseline strategy.
steps.point_out: A banner makes clear every figure is simulated — assumed fees and slippage — never a claim about live results.

expect.text: simulated — assumed fees/slippage — not indicative of live results

steps.title: Open Structure — the price-research page
steps.narration: Now to Structure, the page with Tapeology's price-level research tools: tradable price bands, case studies of past price reactions, and a deeper price-comparison report. This page just wrapped up several rounds of work making sure it always loads quickly, even right after the server restarts.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map panel loads right away, inviting you to choose a symbol and a time to see its level map. Case Studies and the Edge Report sit further down the page, both loading in promptly too.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its tradable level map.

steps.title: An honest answer, with a button ready when someone wants it
steps.narration: Scroll down to the Edge Report panel — the page's deepest calculation. It never runs itself in the background; it waits for a person to ask for it.
steps.point_out: A calm amber message reads "Edge report not computed yet.", with a "Compute edge report" button underneath it — a person can click it anytime to run the calculation on demand; we won't trigger it in this quick tour, since a real run can take a while over the full trading-data history.
